prompt: A glass of water is left in a freezer overnight. The water freezes. Did the temperature of the water drop or stay the same while it was freezing? Explain in one sentence.
gold: Temperature stays at 0 C (freezing point) while the phase change happens; it drops after all ice forms.

swarm-free-3c.text: The temperature of the water remained constant at 0°C until it froze.

swarm-fuse-3c.text: The temperature of the water stayed the same at 0°C as it froze.

review.text:
Here is the list of errors:

* The water froze, but it didn't freeze at 0°C (the freezing point of water is 0°C, but the temperature can drop to just below 0°C as water freezes).
* The statement that the temperature of the water "dropped" while it froze is misleading, as the temperature actually remains at a constant value of 0°C until the water freezes.

FINAL VERDICT: FLAG
